contentText:
Look at that big, beautiful touchscreen. | Image: Fujifilm

Fujifilm is trying to find the right balance of fun and photography with its latest hybrid instant camera. Like its predecessor, the Instax Mini Evo 2 feels less like a retro gimmick, and more like a basic digital camera that just happens to have a built-in printer. It also enjoys some key upgrades: a larger 1/2.77-inch sensor compared to the 1/5-inch sensor on the first Mini Evo , a bigger 4.5-inch rear display with touchscreen controls, and basic video recording too - though only the few seconds leading up to a photo.
